description: Configurable validation rules aligned to the Intain Campus FinTech Challenge 2026 Full Stack Track.

rules.description: Required fields must be present and non-empty.
Origination, maturity and payment dates must be valid ISO dates.
Original principal and current balance cannot be negative.
Maturity date must occur after origination date.
Current balance cannot exceed original principal.
Interest rate should be between 0% and 18%.
Payment status must agree with days past due and closed-loan balance.
Loan IDs must be unique within the source and database.
Borrower, original amount and origination date combinations should not repeat unexpectedly.
Required document status must be available and complete where required.
Records older than 180 days since last update require review.
Borrower state must be a valid US state code.
Conflicting values between loan_tape.csv and servicer_update.csv require reviewer resolution.
Suspiciously repeated borrower records should be surfaced for review.
